# genoaligner

[![CRAN
status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/genoaligner)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=genoaligner)

**Pairwise and multiple sequence alignment for R, from one portable
C++17 core.**

`genoaligner` provides edit-distance (Levenshtein / WFA-equivalent) and
Smith-Waterman local pairwise alignment with score and CIGAR
reconstruction, plus progressive multiple sequence alignment in DNA,
protein and codon-aware modes — all from a self-contained C++17 core
that needs no GPU toolchain, so it builds and runs on CRAN and anywhere
R runs.

``` r

# pairwise, vectorised over pair columns
align_edit(c("AAAACCC", "ACGT"), c("AAAATCC", "ACCT"), smax = 8)
align_sw(c("ACGTACGT", "GGGG"), "ACGTTCGT", scoring = c(2, -3, 5, 2))

# multiple sequence alignment: sequences in -> alignment + QC out
msa_align(c("ACGTACGTAA", "ACGTTCGT", "ACGTACG"))
msa_codon(lepus_cytb$sequence, names = lepus_cytb$accession, gc = 2)
```

## Install

From CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("genoaligner")
```

From GitHub (development head):

``` r

remotes::install_github("alrobles/genoaligner-r")
```

## What is this?

A **pairwise** aligner *and* a **multiple** aligner over the same core:

- **[`align_edit()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/align_edit.md)**
  — edit distance with CIGAR, bounded by `smax`. Pairs whose true
  distance exceeds `smax` are reported unresolved (never silently
  wrong).
- **[`align_sw()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/align_sw.md)**
  — local Smith-Waterman (affine gaps) with CIGAR and the aligned span’s
  coordinates.
- **[`msa_align()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/msa_align.md)**
  — progressive profile–profile MSA with a deterministic
  neighbor-joining guide tree, in `dna` or `protein` mode. Optional
  `iter_refine` rounds realign every guide-tree bipartition, and
  `fft_band` restricts each realignment to a band around
  Fourier-detected homology anchors (MAFFT `FFT-NS-i` class).
- **[`msa_codon()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/msa_codon.md)**
  — codon-aware MSA (MACSE-class): whole-codon indels preserve the
  reading frame by construction; `refine = TRUE` runs a stage-2
  frameshift pass for sequences that truly carry frameshifts. NCBI
  genetic codes 1 (standard) and 2 (vertebrate mitochondrial —
  CYTB/COI/ND).

`msa_*` return a `genoaligner_msa` object carrying the aligned matrix
plus per-sequence QC (reading frame, stop codons, partial codons) — the
QC the library measured travels inside the result.
[`as_dnabin()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/as_dnabin.md)
coerces to [`ape::DNAbin`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/ape/man/DNAbin.html).

> **v2 breaking change:**
> [`align()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/align.md)
> was renamed
> **[`align_edit()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/align_edit.md)**
> — the generic name collides with `Biostrings`/`IRanges` exports in
> mixed sessions.
> [`align()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/align.md)
> remains as a deprecated alias returning identical results.

The wavefront/GPU backend (ROCm/CUDA) that computes the same results
with acceleration lives in the sibling C++ repository.

## Documentation

See the [site](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/): function
reference, the intro vignette, and the codon-aware MSA case study
aligning 37 real hare cytochrome-b records.

# Package index

## Package

- [`genoaligner-package`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/genoaligner-package.md)
  [`genoaligner`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/genoaligner-package.md)
  : genoaligner: GPU-portable pairwise sequence alignment

## Pairwise alignment

- [`align_edit()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/align_edit.md)
  : Align pairs by edit distance
- [`align_sw()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/align_sw.md)
  : Smith-Waterman local alignment

## Multiple sequence alignment

- [`msa_align()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/msa_align.md)
  : Multiple sequence alignment (DNA or protein)
- [`msa_codon()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/msa_codon.md)
  : Codon-aware multiple sequence alignment
- [`as_dnabin()`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/as_dnabin.md)
  : Coerce a genoaligner_msa alignment to ape::DNAbin

## Data

- [`lepus_cytb`](https://alrobles.github.io/genoaligner-r/reference/lepus_cytb.md)
  : Cytochrome b sequences from four leporid species
